Design: Professional, data-driven, sales-optimized. Colors: Navy blue, green, white. Effects: Pipeline drag-drop, chart animations."},{"label":"Social Media Manager","content":"Build a powerful social media manager featuring: multi-platform publishing, content calendar, analytics reports, comment management, team collaboration. Design: Social-first, visually-rich, marketing-oriented. Colors: Colorful, white, dark gray. Effects: Publishing animations, analytics charts."}]},{"icon":"icon-home-dashboard","label":"Dashboard","children":[{"label":"E-commerce Analytics","content":"Build an e-commerce analytics panel for sales trends, top products, cart abandonment, customer value, and inventory alerts. Keep it business-focused with green, blue, and white, using trend motion and product cards to surface key insights."},{"label":"Sales Dashboard","content":"Build a sales dashboard for revenue, funnel performance, team rankings, goal progress, and live deals. Make it competitive and goal-driven with green, gold, and white, using counter and progress animations for momentum."},{"label":"Social Media Analytics","content":"Build a social media analytics panel for follower growth, engagement, top content, sentiment, and competitor tracking. Make it visual and trend-aware with colorful accents, using interactive motion and sentiment charts to highlight performance."}]},{"icon":"icon-page-user-credit","label":"E-commerce","children":[{"label":"Fashion Store","content":"Build a fashion e-commerce site with large product imagery, quick view, size guidance, wishlist actions, and a cart sidebar. Effects: Hand-drawn style animations, story scrolling."},{"label":"NFT Marketplace","content":"Build an NFT marketplace with 3D gallery browsing, wallet connection, contract actions, rarity rankings, and creator royalties. We’ve added **GPT-5.5** and **DeepSeek-V4 Preview** to Atoms.

You can now access both models directly from the model picker for faster execution, stronger reasoning, better coding performance, and smoother long-task workflows.

- **GPT-5.5:** Faster, smarter, and better equipped for real work, with stronger coding, better tool use, and more reliable execution across complex tasks.
- **DeepSeek-V4 Preview:** Built for long-context and agent-ready workflows, with **1M context**, stronger reasoning, richer world knowledge, and improved performance on large documents, long conversations, and multi-step tasks.
- **DeepSeek-V4-Pro:** Available now for higher-performance reasoning, coding, and advanced workflow execution.

---

## 🛠️ Optimizations & Fixes

- **Seamless Model Switching:** Move between models without breaking your flow.
- **Better Long-Task Performance:** Improved support for large documents, extended workflows, and multi-step problem solving.
- **Improved Agent Execution:** Stronger performance across coding, writing, and structured task completion.
- **Platform Stability:** General bug fixes and performance enhancements for a smoother rollout.

---

We’ll keep bringing the latest frontier models into Atoms so you can spend less time operating tools and more time shipping results.
